title: the pictures of the architecture in the notation of the bands
intent: The request of the owner of 23 November (05:32): the pictures of the site name too many files at once -- on the drivers especially the lists of the files are long and the picture is a wall of paths -- and the pictures must be visual, grouped and as small as they can be, and the goal is the clarity of a popular-science text, not a catalogue.  The owner also said: the engine is chosen per picture -- the one that suits the picture.  The wave answers both: four pictures of the architecture are drawn in the notation of D2 (what asks, what decides, what is remembered and what is seen; the person, the editor's Emacs, the agent's Emacs and the bridge; the three placements and the two protocols; and the nine packages of the kernel as one knot), and every leaf of a picture names ONE file of the code, and not a list of files.  The pictures of the classic notation (one turn, the levels of the check, the fixed point) stay in PlantUML, where the notation of UML is the point of the picture.  The picture of the packages no longer draws the modules one by one: the declaration of the picture -- the comment of its source -- names the modules of every package, and the card of every package says how many modules it holds, how many packages it needs and how many packages need it.  The numbers of the cards are measured by the check against the code of the tree, and the knot is measured against the graph of the requires: the nine packages are one strongly connected component, and a picture of layers would say the opposite of the truth.
objection: The knot loses the edges of the graph: the picture of the packages names the nine packages and the numbers of their degrees, and not the 36 edges between them -- a reader of the picture cannot tell which package needs which.  The declaration of the picture holds the membership of the packages and the comment of the picture is the place where the edges would live, and the edges are not drawn anywhere.  The pictures of D2 are not the classic notation of UML: they are bands of boxes with labels, and the owner asked for classic UML in the first place; the pictures that are about a process (one turn, the levels of the check, the fixed point) stay in PlantUML, and the four pictures that are about a structure are drawn in the notation that draws a structure.  The reader of the pictures knows two notations now, and a reader of the reader has to know which is which: the engine of a picture is the extension of its source.  The pictures of D2 are wide (the layers are 1903 pixels and the placements 1837), and the page scales them into its column, so the letters of the picture are smaller than the letters of the pictures of PlantUML.
refuted_by: a leaf of a picture of the architecture names no file, a leaf names a file that is not there, a band of the picture is missing, the note of the picture says nothing, the declaration of the packages drops a module of lib/ or names a module in two packages, the card of a package names a number that the code does not hold, the picture of the site is not the picture of its source, the pipeline does not draw the pictures of D2 in both themes, or the control of a claim does not make its check fail by its own assertion
note:
Measurements of 23 November 2026.  The gate of the project on the tree of the wave: the map is
GREEN -- 185 claims of 185 hold, uncovered 0.  The first gate on this tree refuted the claim
the-documentation-points-at-files-that-exist: the documents named the four pictures of the old
notation (the .puml files that the wave moved), and the claim was true -- the documents were
naming files that the tree does not hold.  Every claim of the pictures held in that run.  The
controls of the six claims of the wave bite: taken out of spec.json and applied to a copy of the
tree, each of them makes its check fail by the assertion of the check (code 1).  The sizes of the
pictures after the wave: the layers 1752x1244, the Emacs layer 2206x1265, the placements
1837x1406, the packages 1203x832; the pictures of PlantUML did not change.  The degrees of the
packages (the numbers of the cards): the journal and the projections 3/7, the tools and the
registry 2/7, the rights and the approvals 2/6, the control of a run 4/4, the interface and the
product 7/3, the placements and the plumbing 5/2, the protocols and the wire 7/1, the adapter of
the model 1/5, the delegation and the subagents 5/1 -- and the graph of the requires of the nine
packages is one strongly connected component (36 edges between the packages).  The pictures of D2
carry the font of the frame with them (DejaVu Sans Mono), so they stand in the same type as the
pictures of PlantUML.
